summary: The proof is mathematically correct and complete. The weighted lattice-centerpoint subargument from bb2b5f9519ae23e8 applies verbatim to the finite positive weights q_s on E and supplies an integer point in conv(E); affinity of the graph map and convexity of C then give graph feasibility even when that integer point is not itself in E. Pulling back every containing ambient halfspace gives either a proper base halfspace or the whole base space, while each relevant fiber section is either a proper halfspace containing s(z) or the whole fiber, so the stated fiber-depth lower bounds sum correctly. The zero-objective, zero-depth, empty-section, whole-space, and maximum-attainment cases are all handled. For n=1, facts 4e868f774de77608, 4bd2e6d22487dfef, and 62f2ec156b347dfe apply with matching hypotheses; the two-endpoint and singleton constructions both produce an affine map with Q_C(s) at least t^d N(t), and the constants multiply exactly as (1/2)(1/4)=1/8, followed by the fiberwise gamma_d bound.
